items: High Performance - The Aiprotablet tablet runs on Android 13, Quad-Core Processor, delivering fast operation and seamless multitasking. Perfect for work, reading, studying, and entertainment.
Latest Model - This 10-inch Android Tablet features Wi-Fi 4 and Bluetooth 4.2, and supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, meeting your daily internet browsing and entertainment needs.

Massive Storage - The tablet comes with 64GB ROM and expandable up to 512GB via microSD card (not included). It comes preloaded with the Google Play Store, so you can easily download any apps you need
HD Large Screen - The tablet is equipped with a 1280x800 low blue light LCD touch screen, which provides clear visuals and vivid colors, ideal for streaming videos, browsing, and comfortable reading.

Durable Battery - With a long-life 6000mAh battery that provides up to 5 days of continuous standby or over 6 hours of use, and fast charging via the Type-C port, you can enjoy your tablet to the fullest.
